description: Essential TOEIC terms focusing on logistics, contract extensions, financial figures, and travel services.

nouns.meaning: sự mở rộng, sự gia hạn, số máy nhánh
nouns.example: If you need more time to finish the report, you can request a two-day extension.

nouns.meaning: cơ sở vật chất, điều kiện thuận lợi
nouns.example: The research facility is equipped with the latest technology in the field.
Location is a key factor to consider when opening a new retail store.
The company plans to build a new factory to increase production capacity.

nouns.meaning: sự thất bại, sự hỏng hóc (máy móc)
nouns.example: The power failure resulted in the loss of unsaved data on many computers.
Many local businesses will participate in the annual job fair this weekend.

nouns.meaning: tiền xe, tiền vé (tàu, xe, máy bay)
nouns.example: Bus fares are expected to increase by ten percent next month.
The technician identified a minor fault in the wiring system.
Could you do me a favor and drop these documents off at the post office?
Please send the signed agreement via fax to our headquarters.
The most impressive feature of the new smartphone is its long battery life.
There is a small processing fee for all credit card transactions.
Positive feedback from customers has boosted the team's morale.

nouns.meaning: con số, số liệu, nhân vật
nouns.example: The latest sales figures show a steady increase in revenue.
I need to organize these files before the meeting starts.
She has a background in international finance and investment.
My flight was delayed due to heavy fog at the airport.
The flight attendant helped the passengers locate their seats.

adjectives.example: The company hired an external consultant to review its safety procedures.
The manager ensures that all team members receive a fair share of the workload.
The city is famed for its historic architecture and vibrant culture.
You can return the faulty goods and ask for a full refund.
The final decision regarding the budget will be made by the CEO.
The company is in a strong financial position following the merger.
We offer flexible working hours to help employees balance work and life.

verbs.meaning: gia hạn, kéo dài, gửi tới
verbs.example: The deadline for the scholarship application has been extended to next Friday.
If the negotiations fail, the company will have to look for a different partner.
How did the new product fare in the international market?
The current tax laws tend to favor large corporations over small businesses.
We need to feedback the results of the survey to the participants.
It took me a while to figure out how to operate the new software.
Please fill out the application form and sign it at the bottom.
The project was financed by a group of private investors.
The IT department is working to fix the server issue as quickly as possible.
